$description: Tier 2, screen family, theme 'light' (day service). Websites, docs pages and the Knowledge Automata guide in light mode.

accent.$description: Accent tint for selected rows and quotes. Fill only, never text.

subtle.$description: All small and supporting text: labels, captions, planned items.

accent.$description: Tomato. Kickers, focus, the one mark that carries meaning.

default.$description: Hairlines. Decorative, not held to 3:1, never carries meaning alone.

strong.$description: Outlines that carry meaning, such as planned items. Needs 3:1 on background and surface.

line.$description: Connectors and arrows in diagrams. Same as text.subtle, as in the editorial light and dark themes.
